correctness.rationale: All essential inferences verified. Lemma R=1+2T mod 4 holds: R=prod(1+a_m) with a_m=2q^m/(1-q^m); products of >=2 factors carry 4; truncation at N uses only m<=N, legitimate for formal series; independently re-derived and coefficient-checked to q^120 (R=1+2T and G=G(q^2)R mod 4 both True). Theorem 4 via phi1 (flip overline-bit of largest value) is fixed-point-free involution, so S(n) even for n>=1 — correct. Theorem 1 convolution: for odd m, S(m)=R(m)+sum_{k>=1}S(k)R(m-2k); m-2k is odd positive when in range, so S(k) even and R(odd>=1)=2t mod 4 even, product 0 mod 4; leaves S(m)=R(m)=2t(m) — correct (m=2k impossible for odd m). Theorem 2: for odd m, t(m)=d(u) with u=m/3^v3, odd iff u square — correct divisor-parity. Corollary 3: t(p)=2 for odd p!=3 gives S(p)=0; S(2)=4; S(3^a)=2 since stripped part is 1; even lift S(2n)=S(n)+2t(2n) follows from G=G(q^2)R separating k=n term (other terms even*even), verified to 120; S(2m)=0 for odd m follows by 0+0/2+2 cases. Non-closure S(4)=10, S(12)=198 both 2 mod 4 confirmed in JSON. Witness: phi1/psi commuting fixed-point-free involutions; size-2 orbit requires phi1(x)=psi(x) given fixed-point-freeness (stabilizer {1,ab} case), impossible with >=2 values (differ on coordinates >=1); rectangles for odd m are exactly 2*t(m) (v odd divisor prime to 3 times 2 bits) — proved, plus assertion audit to 25 replayed OK (e.g. m=25: 2973+2973, rect 6=2t(25)). DP S values cross-checked by independent brute overpartition enumeration to n=10 (1,2,4,6,10,16,24,36,52,74,104 match). No proof/computation confusion: DRAFT states proofs are all-n formal series, N=120 is corroboration.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Sang-Shi arXiv:1712.08930 proves analytic mod-4 dissections including S(4n+2)=0 for k=2 mod 4, i=3 mod 4 (covers S_{6,3}), and S(3n+2)=0 mod 4 for k=i=0 mod 3, via Hirschhorn-Sellers dissections; it contains no odd dichotomy S(m)=2t(m), no square criterion m/3^v3 square iff 2 mod 4, no prime family S(p)=0 for p!=3, and no involution/crank witness. Chen-Hirschhorn-Sellers arXiv:1405.3626 proves infinite mod-3 family for Qbar_{3,1}, different modulus, no mod-4 odd classification or witness. Live arXiv search 'singular overpartition crank' returns zero results; 'overpartition crank congruence' returns 6 hits covering only distinct objects (Wagner/Chakravarthy-Males-Shen (k,j)-coloured, spt-cranks, rank/crank moments, overpartition pairs, t-cores) — no k=3 singular crank/witness. Combined analytic congruence alone does not mechanically imply the exact 2t(m) refinement or the V4 bijective decomposition; crank/witness requires new construction. DRAFT honestly acknowledges the S(4n+2) overlap with Sang-Shi (4.33) and limits novelty to lemma, square criterion, and witness — none recorded in checked sources.

value.rationale: Headline claim judged separately from abandoned 3/4-way crank plan (honestly dropped, Sec.6). Object S(n)=overpartitions with parts prime to 3 = Andrews Qbar_{3,1}=RRG Abar_{3,3,1} was motivated before computation (Andrews notes, Sang-Shi identification). Value is exact mod-4 classification of all odd m (square criterion), prime family, and one-step doubling with explicit non-closure, proved twice (elementary q-series + V4 bijective orbit decomposition) — not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration. It strictly strengthens the known single progression S(4n+2)=0 to a complete odd dichotomy plus combinatorial witness, answering the noted missing witness gap in the Dyson-Andrews-Garvan-Mahlburg program for this canonical k=3 case. A future overpartition/mock-theta worker could reasonably need the precise S(m) mod 4 rule and the rectangle/V4 decomposition. Narrow exact datum is eligible per standard: motivated natural object, unknown value, citable.
